name: antas-promo
description: The Antas promotional video. A separate package on purpose - Remotion's renderer pulls in a headless browser and ffmpeg, and none of that belongs in the deployed application's dependency tree.
//playwright: Deliberately NOT a dependency here. capture.mjs resolves playwright from the repo root, where it is already installed with its browsers downloaded. A second copy would mean a second ~150MB browser download and two versions to keep in step.
